usage.finalMessage:
I added the `move` command (it uses the same booking rules as `book`) and listed it in `help` right after `cancel`. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes all 6 tests, including one I added to check that a refused move changes nothing.
Two open questions: the slot rule (`Rules.slotFree`) lets clinician k2 be double-booked, which no decision record covers, and moves now follow it too. Also, moving an appointment to the slot it already has is refused as "already booked".
The report is in `.work/report.json`, and both are committed.

OUTCOME: completed
